name: Hinohara (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Hinohara village emblem in white: a ring beneath a broad winged device.
history: Municipal flag of Hinohara, a village in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1979.

features.role: Hinohara village emblem — a ring beneath a broad winged device
